chunks: A tawaf before hajj is better than seventy tawafs after hajj.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: better; more virtuous and superior in reward
key_terms.بَعْدَ: after; indicating what follows in time
key_terms.سَبْعِينَ: seventy; used here to express great multiplication
key_terms.طَوَافٌ: circumambulation of the Ka'bah as an act of worship

ai.seo_question: Why is a tawaf before hajj better than many tawafs after hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great merit of performing tawaf before hajj. It emphasizes the special virtue and elevated rank of devotional acts done in connection with hajj at their proper time.
